name: {{project-name}}
description: {{PROJECT_NAME}} — HTML prototype with 11ty, Tailwind v4, and design-system-agnostic tokens

scripts.build:production: npm run build:css && TAILWIND_MODE=compiled npm run build
scripts.og:generate: SITE_INDEXABLE=true TAILWIND_MODE=compiled npm run build && node scripts/generate-og-images.mjs && SITE_INDEXABLE=true TAILWIND_MODE=compiled npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run check:content && npm run check:design && npm test && npm run build:production && npm run verify:build && SITE_INDEXABLE=true TAILWIND_MODE=compiled npm run build && npm run check:og-images
scripts.build:inline: npm run build:standalone && npm run build:spa
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:inline
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run build:all && npm run dev
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:js: eslint src/assets/js/ src/_data/ src/_lib/ scripts/ test/ eleventy.config.js
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src/assets/js/ src/_data/ src/_lib/ scripts/ test/ eleventy.config.js --fix
